thread:
maya: Heads-up — we're seeing a sustained spike of 503/504s from the hosted edge: started ~06:10 UTC. Multiple customer escalations coming in. Opening triage here.
liam: I'm joining. Which routes are affected?
maya: Mostly text-generation endpoints (v1/generate) in eu-west and us-central. Error rate ~18% on avg, up to 40% on some prefixes.
devon: Early signal looks like TLS handshake failures at the edge (SYN+RST patterns). I pulled pcap from one front node.
sarah: Support notes: two paying customers reported timeouts at 06:15 and 06:18, severity P1. Tickets #INC-1124 and #INC-1125.
opsbot: Alert: hosted-edge-01 latency > 1s and 5xx rate > 9% for prefix /v1/generate (metric window 5m).
maya: Repro attempt: curl against edge with --resolve to our IP shows intermittent `502 Bad Gateway` and `504 Gateway Timeout`.
liam: Can you paste the minimal curl you used?
maya: `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate" -d '{"prompt":"test"}'` — sometimes the TCP handshake stalls, then eventually 504.
devon: Snippet from edge logs (truncated):
```
2026-03-17T06:12:03Z edge-01 tls_handshake_fail client_ip=10.7.3.21 upstream=10.9.4.12 err=EOF
2026-03-17T06:12:04Z edge-01 upstream_timeout route=/v1/generate upstream=backend-c-7 code=504
2026-03-17T06:13:10Z edge-04 conn_reset client_ip=52.14.2.9 upstream=10.9.4.14 err=write: broken pipe
```
liam: Those `tls_handshake_fail` entries line up with our HAProxy health checks flapping. Any recent cert rotations or TLS config changes?

albert: No cert rotations in the last 48h. We did push a kernel update to edge fleet at 02:00 for BPF netfilter fixes — rolling across nodes.
sarah: Could the kernel change cause SYN retries/handshake issues?
devon: Possible. I'm seeing a correlation: nodes upgraded show higher handshake-fail counts. Rolling back kernel might be risky; alternative is to divert traffic off suspect nodes.
maya: Mitigation proposal: 1) Mark affected edge nodes as drained in LB, 2) Increase timeout/retry on gateway to reduce 5xx surface, 3) Enable fallback routing to dedicated region for affected customers. Who can run the drain?
liam: I can drain edge-01 and edge-04 now. Doing `sudo /usr/local/bin/drain_node edge-01`
opsbot: Action logged: liam drained edge-01 at 2026-03-17T06:24:10Z.
liam: Drained node edge-01, traffic shifted. Monitoring.
maya: After drain, 5xx rate dropped from 18% to 6% in the next 2 minutes. Good signal.
tilly: Noted customer impact: INC-1124 updated: they reported improvement around 06:28.
devon: Short-term root cause likely kernel patch interacting with our TLS stack leading to handshake stalls under load. We should halt further kernel rollouts.
albert: I already paused the rollout in staging and prod fleets at 06:20.
sarah: Forensics: need to capture tcpdump + openssl s_client trace on one affected host before we fully reboot or roll back.
maya: Assigning action items:
- devon: capture tcpdump + s_client on one repro host and upload to S3 (ETA 1h)
- albert: prepare rollback plan for kernel update and test on single canary (ETA 2h)
- liam: run a controlled un-drain and monitor (ETA 30m)
- sarah: update customer tickets with timeline + mitigation notes (ongoing)

devon: I'll run `tcpdump -i eth0 -w /tmp/edge-handshake.pcap port 443 and host 10.9.4.14` and `openssl s_client -connect 127.0.0.1:443 -msg` and attach pcaps to S3 `s3://redwood-incident/4467890123/`.
maya: Postmortem follow-ups (tentative):
- Stop kernel rollout until root cause confirmed (owner: infra, due: 2026-03-17 12:00 UTC)
- Add TLS handshake error alerts at node-level (owner: eng-sre, due: 48h)
- Improve deploy rollback runbook for kernel packages (owner: eng-infra, due: 72h)
- Run load test on upgraded kernel in staging with our TLS workload (owner: eng-runtime, due: 5 days)

liam: Will create the postmortem doc and link to this thread.
opsbot: Incident severity set to P1. Rolling retention snapshot created.
maya: Final check: anything else we need before we close triage?
devon: One more: check autoscales on dedicated so they didn't get overloaded during traffic shift. I'll validate.
sarah: Support will send a summarized customer communication once we confirm rollback plan.
maya: Thanks all. Keeping incident open for follow-ups. Closing active mitigation at 06:40 UTC — leaving monitoring enabled.
liam: Closing note: we've tagged all related logs with `incident=4467890123` for traceability.
maya: Logged action items in Asana and assigned owners. Will ping when postmortem draft is ready. :white_check_mark:
